ui.title: Test Automation Generator
ui.tagline: Writes the tests a pull request is missing: reads the change and your testing conventions, plans the tests, writes them on a branch, runs them in CI, and comments with the coverage gain - failing tests go to a developer, who decides whether they found a bug or are wrong.

actions.label: Run: Tests for a pull request
actions.description: A pull request opens. Kaman reads what changed and your testing conventions in parallel, plans the missing tests, writes them on a branch, runs them in CI, and comments on the pull request when they pass and add coverage; failing or coverage-reducing tests go to a developer first.

actions.label: Ask the Change Reader
actions.description: Reads a pull request's changes and the tests that already cover them.
